I nearly died once from a previous drug I was prescribed by him due to a serious and sometimes fatal side effect called Neuroleptic Malignant Syndrome and instead of allowing me to go through the withdrawals of my medication, he forced me out of my bed at home into hospital and onto the injectable form of a different anti-psychotic which could have caused me severe side effects also but he did not care about the risk whatsoever.

I was simply delirious from insomnia due to the withdrawals and had smoked some cannabis to help me sleep but he mistook it for schizophrenia even though there are new scientific papers coming out now proving that insomnia can cause psychotic like experiences. This is from the National Institutes for Health for example: "Studies suggest that insomnia can precede and predict psychotic experiences like paranoia and hallucinations". As a psychiatrist he should have known this but he obviously did not.

He likes to hide behind the law and threaten me with getting the police involved, I assume to pin me down while they inject me if I try to refuse my meds, which is simply cowardly and reprehensible
